# Build With Bonventure

> Professional civil & structural engineering, construction, and maintenance services across Kenya. Tagline: Engineering Trust.

Build With Bonventure is a Kenya-based engineering and construction company led by Bonventure, a qualified civil & structural engineer. Services include structural design, building works, electrical and plumbing, interior design, landscaping, CCTV and electric fence installation, architectural and structural drawings, tank cleaning, and repairs.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, featured projects, and lead engineer Bonventure.
- [About](/about): Mission, values, and the engineer behind the brand.
- [Services](/services): Full list of civil, structural, building, security and maintenance services.
- [Projects](/projects): Selected portfolio of completed civil, structural and construction work.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Client reviews from homeowners, developers and businesses.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone, WhatsApp, email and quote request form.
